        headers, _ = self.createSession(login_credentials['usernameAdmin'], login_credentials['passwordAdmin'])

        request_payload["date"] = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")

        assert response.status_code == 200
